treatment.reference: Restrained launch-film pacing with full-bleed UI, macro crops, warm paper and ink colors, deliberate cursor choreography, and sparse editorial text.
treatment.evidenceRule: Real capture supplies all interface behavior, WebMCP calls, approval, printer operation, and finished paper.
treatment.audioRule: Pete's narration stays effortless to hear; jazz remains low; real printer sound leads the opening and physical payoff.

copy: A website, an agent, and a real printer.
sequences.proof: Show the finished physical result before explaining it.
Establish the browser, local printer, and human context in one frame.
Show a real direct edit on the dot-accurate receipt canvas.
Keep the named structured tool call readable.
Show the real Lisbon countdown, flight facts, weather, and grouped packing.
Show one line changing while the rest of the document remains stable.
Use captured output values; never leave placeholder measurements in the final.
Hold long enough to read revision, dimensions, destination, and cancellation behavior.
Match-cut the real approval to the real printer producing the same receipt.
End on readable paper in a believable place of use.
